admission.accounting: Reduced compressor work also reduces recovered heat. No addition to the213.69MW reactor figure and no annual-availability claim.
admission.cases: Mean and outlet property approximations, each at zero omitted equal branch loss and at the shared topology's remaining550kPa allowance. Endpoints are budgets, not measured header losses.
admission.classification: Reference-driven design comparison; not a new loop solver or new hydraulic principle
admission.compression: Solve suction temperature with real-helium entropy and enthalpy so discharge temperature remains fixed; also close a four-state heat ledger and cross-check ideal-gas algebra.
admission.decision: Whether to retain the published independent topology as preferred next reference and the budget for extra losses/auxiliaries before any net benefit is erased.
admission.fixed_boundary: Candidate helium pump discharge 8MPa and573.13K; branch mass flow/heat from previous solved nominal split. Eta_isentropic0.9, electrical-to-shaft0.87, recovered-heat conversion0.4 remain assumptions.
admission.not_free: Independent circuits require their own controls, cooling trains and spatial hardware. Within-region unequal flow, compressor maps, cold-side HX feasibility, pressure-vessel stress and neutron/material allocation remain open.

primary_references.scope: Full author manuscript read, Figure5 inspected; four independent circuits, two IB and two OB; manifold losses absent and ex-vessel components excluded in reported simulations.
CompressorBase source inspected; reuse enthalpy/entropy/efficiency equations only. No Modelica execution or full GETTHEM reproduction.
Publisher text and institutional abstract inspected; geometry-specific manifold thermomechanical issues remain despite thickness changes. No stress coefficients transferred.

admission.question: At the same candidate heat and branch flows, what is the pumping/heat-recovery trade of the published independent IB/OB topology versus the hypothetical common-pressure balanced topology?
admission.stop_rule: Complete this finite topology comparison and numerical cross-checks once; do not build a general whole-loop simulator or repeat manifold-parameter sweeps.
